corrections.reason: The 3rd person masculine plural imperfect verb in Acts 17:11 is የኀሥሡ (translated in the next line as ይሹ ፡ ይመረምሩ ፡ ነበር), and the 2nd-order stroke on ሡ is visible on the right leg.
Classical Ge'ez plural of ካልእ is ካልኣን (4th-order ኣ), matching the shorter left leg of ኣ visible in the print.
Classical Ge'ez plural form ወካልኣን (4th-order ኣ) is printed on the page and required by grammar.
The printed scripture citation is ፩ ፡ ቆሮ ፡ ፲፭፥፲፪ (1 Corinthians 15:12, concerning the resurrection from the dead); the tightly spaced numerals ፲፭ were misread as ፬.
